decisions.what: Track sprite metadata in a parallel Map<SpriteId, SpriteMetadata> inside SpriteManager
decisions.why: Metadata like layerName, textureKey, and the scalar scale are not directly recoverable from a Pixi Sprite; the shadow map keeps getAllSprites() accurate without extra bookkeeping in callers.

decisions.what: TextureCache placeholder built from a 1x1 magenta HTMLCanvasElement
decisions.why: Spec asks for a 1x1 magenta placeholder created in the constructor; a canvas-backed Texture works in browsers and jsdom, with Texture.EMPTY as a safety fallback.

decisions.what: SpriteManager.loadTexture uses textureKey as both key and url
decisions.why: SpriteConfig only carries textureKey; treating it as the URL lets the same key drive cache lookup and network fetch without introducing another field.

decisions.what: Integration tests stub Application.init and mock Assets.load
decisions.why: PixiJS Application requires WebGL and Assets fetches over the network; stubbing them mirrors the existing CanvasEngine integration test and keeps the sprite pipeline exercised end-to-end under jsdom.

decisions.what: CanvasEngine.destroy clears sprites and texture cache before tearing down Pixi resources
decisions.why: Spec requires destroy() to clean up the sprite/texture systems in addition to the existing engine teardown.
